name: LBO Sanity Check

inputs.name: LBO model or headline assumptions (entry/exit multiple, leverage, growth, margins, hold)
Context: live deal review, screening or interview case

steps.title: Decompose returns
steps.detail: Bridge from entry equity to exit equity: deleveraging, EBITDA growth, margin change, multiple change. Attribute the MOIC.

steps.title: Name the load-bearing driver
steps.detail: Every LBO has one assumption doing most of the work. Find it.

steps.title: Benchmark the assumptions
steps.detail: Entry vs comparable deals, growth vs company history, exit multiple vs entry (expansion needs a story).

steps.title: Test the downside
steps.detail: Flat EBITDA, exit at entry multiple, one turn less leverage — does the deal still clear the hurdle?

steps.title: Write the challenges
steps.detail: The 3-5 questions the IC will ask, with the numbers that answer them.

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Computing the returns attribution bridge from the model

steps.title: Delegate 2
steps.detail: Building the sensitivity grid (exit multiple × growth)

steps.title: Delegate 3
steps.detail: Pulling comparable-deal entry multiples where public

sections.name: Returns-driver decomposition + challenge list
sections.detail: Decompose an LBO’s returns into leverage, EBITDA growth, margin change and multiple expansion — then interrogate whichever driver carries the deal. The fastest way to look sharp in a PE seat or interview.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.

verification.description: The bridge actually reconciles to the model’s MOIC/IRR
Debt paydown in the bridge matches the model’s FCF sweep
Sensitivities flex the right cells (no dead inputs)
MOIC attribution sums to total MOIC
Every challenged assumption has a benchmark
Downside case is stated with its return, not just direction

humanCheckpoints: Whether the load-bearing assumption is believable
What downside case is the honest one for THIS business
Deal-breaker vs negotiating point vs acceptable risk

display.jobToBeDone: Review an LBO’s returns drivers and catch the assumptions doing the heavy lifting.
